what_you_do: You write down what you want to start and what you'll work on today, then read both twice.

method.name: Stating your goal (the comparison exercise)
method.text: Research on if-then planning compares people who make a plan with people who only state their goal. This exercise is that plain version: no “when”, no if-then plan and no plan for obstacles. You can try it next to “Plan your first step” and compare.

research.text: Research found that adding an if-then plan led to more goal progress than stating the goal alone. Stating the goal was the point of comparison in that research, not a method tested on its own.

about_this_exercise: This exercise hasn't been tested itself. It is offered so that you can try the plain version and compare it with the planning one.
limits: Don't expect this exercise to change much by itself: it is the comparison version.
